title: Humpty branch-reconciliation review package

plan.objective: Turn Humpty's patchwork and cream-blue historical branches into an explicit canon decision without silent promotion.
steps: Review both branches as separate historical production evidence.
Compare shell shape, color blocking, face, hat or bow accessories, role, and episode history.
Choose global canon, production-specific variants, separate characters, or continued hold.
Define which branch, if any, may be used in future productions.

findings.message: The rainbow-patchwork and cream-blue branches differ in identity-defining color and accessory language.
Both branches remain historical production evidence and neither is promoted automatically.

branches.description: Rainbow patchwork egg character from the grocery-store branch.
Cream egg with blue bow and blue-yellow hat from the platform branch.

next_gate: Present both branches and decision options for explicit Character Canon approval.
